description: Replica of the K5Y1 trainer type flown by Adisutjipto in 1945-46. aviahistoria.com records that the Jakarta and Yogyakarta museums exchanged their Cureng replicas and that the better example, carrying TJ-62, remained in Jakarta.

Japanese advanced trainer, displayed marked '01'. Pacific Wrecks records a Ki-79 as having been moved from Satriamandala to the air force museum; aviahistoria.com photographed it at Satriamandala in 2022, which is taken as current.
Canadian-built Harvard IIB in AURI markings.
Cavalier Mustang II rebuild of a P-51D, supplied to the AURI in 1973.

Stand-in for the historic Dakota RI-001 'Seulawah', bought with Acehnese gold in 1948; the original has disappeared. This airframe is an ex-Garuda Indonesia DC-3 registered PK-GDZ, on display since 1976 and raised on concrete piers after the 2002 and 2007 Jakarta floods. Paint and markings are badly faded.
aliases: DC-3; DC3; C47; PKGDZ; RI-001; RI001; Seulawah

description: Ex-Indonesian Navy (ALRI) Gannet anti-submarine aircraft. Displayed carrying the marking 'AS 00'; aviahistoria.com treats this as a display marking rather than a full serial, so tail_number is left blank.
Ex-Indonesian Army (Penerbad) Mi-4; the HA- prefix denotes Army aviation.
Ex-AURI MiG-21F-13; stands at the museum frontage on Jl. Gatot Subroto.
Ex-Skadron Udara 11/12 Skyhawk, added to the collection 14 March 2017.
Added to the collection in 2021 as the museum's newest airframe.
SA-2 Guideline missile on its launcher in the museum's outdoor weapons park.
